```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
grid <- read_csv("data/processed_grid/processed_grid.csv")
time_grid <- st_read("../DATA-510/time_grid/time_grid.shp")
```

```{r}
saveRDS(object = grid, file="./data/processed_grid/processed_grid.rds")
saveRDS(object = time_grid, file="./data/processed_grid/time_grid.rds")
```
